readiness.intro: One number that tells you what to do next before placements. It is the sum of the parts below, and your college sets how much each part counts.
readiness.headline: You’re at {{score}}.
readiness.nextIntro: Next, the steps that add the most:
readiness.allDone: Every part is as high as it goes. Keep practising before each drive.
readiness.renormalised: Not counted for you yet: {{parts}}. Your score counts the other parts, scaled to 100.
readiness.parts: What your score is made of
readiness.how: Each part earns points out of its share. The points add up to your score; nothing else goes into it.
readiness.private: Only you and your college’s placement cell and faculty see your score. Other students and employers never do.

action.check_resume: Run the ATS check on your résumé
action.add_keywords_one: Add {{count}} missing keyword to your résumé
action.add_keywords_other: Add {{count}} missing keywords to your résumé
action.check_against_role: Check your résumé against a role
action.improve_answers: Work on the {{dimension}} of your answers
action.pick_roadmap: Follow a roadmap for the role you want
action.book_session: Have a session with a mentor
action.raise_cgpa: Reach a CGPA of {{cgpa}} to open more drives

facts.off: Your college does not count this part.
facts.notAvailable: Not part of the app yet. Its share goes to the other parts.
facts.noCutoffs: Your college’s drives have not set academic cut-offs yet.
facts.unchecked: Your résumé has not been checked yet.
facts.interviewsUnscored: {{mocks}} mock interviews in the last 90 days, not scored yet.
facts.interviews: {{mocks}} mock interviews in the last 90 days, average {{average}} of 5.
facts.noRoadmap: You are not following a roadmap yet.
facts.mentorship_one: {{count}} session with a mentor in the last year.
facts.mentorship_other: {{count}} sessions with a mentor in the last year.
facts.pending: Your academic record is waiting for the placement cell to verify it.
facts.eligibility: Your CGPA of {{cgpa}} meets the cut-offs of {{meets}} of {{drives}} recent drives.

readinessBoard.intro: How ready each batch and branch is, and who needs help before a drive closes. Counts under five are hidden; minors are never listed.
readinessBoard.privacy: Scores are visible only to the placement cell and faculty, never to other students or employers. Exports are recorded in the audit log.

weights.title: How the score is made
weights.body: Give each part a weight from 0 (not counted) to 50. Weights are scaled so the score is out of 100.
weights.notAvailable: Not in the app yet: its weight goes to the other parts.
weights.thresholdHint: Students under this score are listed when a drive closes soon.
weights.closingHint: How soon a drive must close for a student to be listed.
weights.none: Give at least one part a weight.

nudge.body: Each gets one message naming the drive and when it closes, with a link to their next steps. Their score is never in it.
nudge.caps: A student is nudged at most once a week. WhatsApp goes only to students who opted in, within their weekly limit and your college’s allowance; others get it in the app.

help.title: Needs help
help.intro: Students below {{threshold}} whose next eligible drive closes within {{days}} days, soonest first.
help.emptyBody: No student below the threshold has a drive closing soon.

dist.title: Distribution
dist.intro: Students per score band, by batch and branch.
